name_zh: 曼萨·穆萨/马里/黄金/麦加朝觐/廷巴克图/伊斯兰/帝国
description_zh: 13世纪西非帝国马里皇帝，伊斯兰世界著名统治者，黄金贸易巨头，麦加朝觐传奇，廷巴克图学术中心推动者
description_en: 13th-century emperor of the Mali Empire, renowned ruler in the Islamic world, gold trade magnate, legendary Makkah pilgrim, promoter of Timbuktu academic center
reason_zh: 曼萨·穆萨领导马里帝国达到鼎盛，通过黄金外交和伊斯兰学术推动跨撒哈拉帝国贸易，促进廷巴克图成为学术中心。黄金财富支持麦加朝觐，展示伊斯兰世界实力。
reason_en: Mansa Musa led the Mali Empire to its zenith, driving trans-Saharan trade through gold diplomacy and Islamic scholarship, promoting Timbuktu as an academic center. Gold wealth supported the legendary Makkah pilgrimage, showcasing Islamic world power.
steps_zh: 巩固马里帝国版图，控制西非黄金贸易
推动伊斯兰教在西非传播，建立宗教学校
资助廷巴克图作为学术和贸易中心的发展
率领大规模朝觐团前往麦加，展示帝国财富
建立外交关系，与埃及、尼日尔等国家交往
steps_en: Consolidate Mali Empire territory, control West African gold trade
Promote Islam in West Africa, establish religious schools
Fund Timbuktu's development as an academic and trade center
Lead a massive pilgrimage to Makkah, showcasing imperial wealth
Establish diplomatic relations with Egypt, Niger, and other states
expected_zh: 马里帝国达到鼎盛，廷巴克图成为学术中心，跨撒哈拉贸易繁荣，伊斯兰文化广泛传播
expected_en: Mali Empire reaches zenith, Timbuktu becomes academic center, trans-Saharan trade flourishes, Islam spreads widely
case_zh: 1324年曼萨·穆萨率领600人朝觐团前往麦加，携带大量黄金，展示马里帝国财富，在伊斯兰世界留下深刻印象。
case_en: In 1324, Mansa Musa led a 600-person pilgrimage to Makkah, carrying vast quantities of gold, showcasing the Mali Empire's wealth and leaving a profound impression in the Islamic world.
intellectual_tradition_zh: 伊斯兰学术、黄金贸易、帝国管理
intellectual_tradition_en: Islamic scholarship, gold trade, imperial administration
cross_cultural_impact_zh: 连接西非与伊斯兰世界，通过黄金外交促进跨文化交流，促进廷巴克图成为跨撒哈拉学术中心
cross_cultural_impact_en: Connected West Africa with the Islamic world, promoted cross-cultural exchange through gold diplomacy, helped establish Timbuktu as a trans-Saharan academic center
